name: Together AI platform landing page by together.ai
description: A polished AI infrastructure landing page moves from a pale blue, split hero with oversized black-and-gray typography and a colorful abstract 3D composition into progressively denser product proof. The white middle sections use centered headings, pastel metric cards, tabbed capability panels, and restrained rules; a full-width near-black research section creates the main contrast break with compact editorial cards. Below that, generous whitespace frames customer stories, a structured blog grid, and a pale-blue CTA that resolves into a large rounded white mega-footer over soft abstract color fields.
